protocol: LLM text-extraction measurement protocol v1.1 (double-annotated gold-standard subset: 1,470 reports across three text domains)

extractors.model_version: qwen2.5 14b/7b instruct; glm-4-9b-chat (Ollama default quantization, tag logged per batch)
extractors.gold_standard_file: data/gold_ecg_H.csv (570 reports, full deduplicated stratified sample)
extractors.annotators: A1 (medical-imaging physician, intermediate grade, general practice, 1-year ultrasound rotation); A2 (clinical-medicine physician, intermediate grade, general practice, 2-year medical-technology rotations)

below_gate.ecg_other: kappa=0.685, acc=0.963; 15 false negatives are all isolated left-ventricular-high-voltage statements (annotator consensus other=1 conflicts with the arbitrated convention ECG_0175/codebook v2.0 — gold-standard convention inconsistency, the model follows the arbitrated convention); 6 false positives are findings not enumerated in the manual other-list (aberrant conduction x3, QT prolongation, short PR, one domain-contaminated text)

acceptance.summary: qwen2.5:14b 11/12 PASS (kappa 0.92-1.00), 7b 7/12, glm4 7/12; any-abnormal per-year kappa: 14b 0.966-1.000 in every year (including the 2022-23 template transition), dict v1 collapses to 0.41 in the same years, dict v3 1.000 (rules share the annotation manual)

extractors.note: ECG 12-variable multi-label prompt v1 (mirrors codebook v2.0 conventions: early repolarisation / high voltage / AF with rapid ventricular rate / sinoatrial block / domain-mismatch rules); 570-report validation batch run 2026-09-09

extractors.gold_standard_file: data/gold_echo_PG_300.csv (300, nested subset of the 600-report rule-stratified parent)

prerun.note: v1-prompt pre-run (no rhythm field); re-run with prompt v2 for gold-standard acceptance

prompt_v2_1_changes: synchronised with annotation manual v2.0: LVH >= 12 mm and left-atrial diameter >= 40 mm both threshold-inclusive
added: pericardial effusion / intracardiac echogenicity of uncertain nature counts as structural abnormality -> label=abnormal
added: unreadable definition includes domain mismatch (non-cardiac-ultrasound content)
added: left-atrial transverse diameters are descriptive only and excluded from the 40-mm threshold (basis: gold-standard frozen convention, case ECHO_0232)
added: explicit label aggregation rule (any abnormal field=1 -> abnormal)
reflux_grade: most severe grade when multiple valves involved (explicit)

acceptance.score_mode: derived scoring: echo_normal / echo_variant deterministically derived from frozen structured fields plus the label field

variable_notes.echo_la_dilate: below-gate restricted use: kappa=0.877/acc=0.973 pass, F1_pos=0.892 below the 0.90 gate (8 false positives: 4 sub-threshold misjudgements, 2 non-enumerated phrasings, 1 without quadrant diameter, 1 LV/LA confusion); 95% CI overlaps 0.90
variable_notes.echo_variant: below-gate restricted use: kappa=0.833 but acc=0.936/F1=0.876 below gate; errors largely inherited from reflux grading and 7 gold-variant rows with reflux != trace_mild convention noise

extractors.gold_standard_file: data/gold_abdus_PG_300.csv (300, nested subset of the 600-report rule-stratified parent)

rules: main analysis uses only status=frozen, gate-passing extractors
model/prompt upgrades are analysed as sensitivity analyses only, never back-written to the production database
every batch logs input/output SHA-256 hashes (logged automatically by the batch runner)

runtime_disclosure.ollama_version: not logged at batch time — to be re-verified and recorded in the release environment (cross-hardware bit-exact determinism is not claimed; see manuscript Limitations)
runtime_disclosure.determinism: temperature=0 + seed=42; deterministic within identical software/hardware environments only
